notes.title: March 16, 2024 Version 1.3 Update Announcement
notes.content:
This is an update for Version 1.3, with the main updates as follows:
- Optimization of the beginner's guide.
- Improvement in the interaction experience of counterattacks.
- Optimization of animations and AI for all bosses, making battles smoother and more comfortable.

notes.title: December 24, 2023 Version 1.2 Update Announcement
notes.content:
Dear players, we are thrilled to announce that our game has been upgraded to version 1.2! We've made some significant improvements and additions in this update to provide a better gaming experience. Here are the main contents of this update:

- Comprehensive optimization of the beginner's guide: We have thoroughly upgraded and improved the beginner's guide, enabling players to grasp game skills and gameplay more quickly and intuitively.
- Upgrade of melee and long-range counterattack interaction experience: We've added new melee and long-range counterattack interaction experiences, making the battles more realistic and intense.
- Significant performance optimization: In order to provide a smoother gaming experience, we've carried out large-scale performance optimization. We don't want frame drops to be the cause of players' defeat in battles.
- English voice pack update: We've updated the English voice pack.
- Comprehensive special effects upgrade: We've comprehensively updated and supplemented the game's special effects, allowing players to experience a more realistic fantasy world.
- Sound effect adjustments: We've made meticulous adjustments to the game's sound effects, making each sound effect perform more harmoniously, allowing players to enjoy a better auditory experience in the game.

We are always committed to providing players with the best gaming experience. Thank you for your continued support and companionship, we hope you will like this update. Happy gaming everyone!
